chapters.title: Submitting expenses in the web app
Approving or sending back for revision

features.name: Default approver setup
features.description: Administrator can set a default approver who approves expenses for everyone in the company by default. This is optional and can be overridden per user.
caveats: can be overridden per individual user

features.name: Per-user approver override
features.description: Individual users can have a different approver assigned than the default approver. Approvers must have the Can Approve flag enabled.
caveats: approver must have Can Approve flag enabled
system enforces that chosen approver can approve

features.name: Expense report submission
features.description: Users can submit expense reports through the Expense Agent web app. Submission triggers email notification to the assigned approver, with the submitter in CC.
caveats: requires email address configured in Business Central

features.name: Approver email notification
features.description: When an expense report is submitted, the approver receives an email notification with a link to review the report and high-level description.

features.name: Report review and receipt inspection
features.description: Approver can review high-level report details and zoom into attached receipts to verify all information before approval decision.

features.name: Send back for revision with comments
features.description: Approver can send an expense report back to the submitter with comments explaining what needs to be changed or corrected.

features.name: Approval and posting
features.description: When approver approves an expense report, it is marked as approved in Business Central and the process continues with posting, reimbursement, and other post-approval steps.

features.name: Approver licensing requirement
features.description: An approver must have a Business Central license and be a user in Business Central. Submitters do not need to be licensed users.
caveats: only applies to approvers, not submitters

features.name: Resubmit after revision
features.description: After receiving feedback with comments, users can revise their expense report and resubmit it for the approver to review again.

features.name: Reminders for unsubmitted reports
features.description: Administrator can configure reminders to be sent to users who have expense reports ready but not yet submitted. Reminder frequency can be customized.

features.name: Expense Agent policies
features.description: Future capability to enforce company policies on expense reports, such as requiring partner names in report descriptions for partner visits.
features.status_evidence_quote: There might be something coming soon about policies, so stay tuned for new Expense Agent changes

features.name: Enhanced approval workflows
features.description: Future improvements to the approval setup beyond the current basic approver assignment, with more sophisticated approval routing.
features.status_evidence_quote: we have some more improvements coming for the approvals in uh expense agent. So, stay tuned and um for the next wave of improvements
